messages:
Taylor Nguyen: Wrapping up the postmortem for the KV-cache invalidation incident. I put together a set of concrete actions and proposed owners. Please call dibs or reassign by EOD.
Priya Shah: Thanks Taylor. Can you paste the actions here so we have them inline?
Taylor Nguyen: Sure 12 condensed list below: 
- ACT1: Add deterministic cache invalidation metric and alert (owner: Priya, due: 2026-04-02, JIRA: RED-2201)
- ACT2: Implement sticky routing for long-running decode requests to avoid KV misses (owner: Liam, due: 2026-04-16, JIRA: RED-2202)
- ACT3: Backfill missing trace data for the 2026-02 recurrence pattern and annotate runbook (owner: Nora, due: 2026-03-31, JIRA: RED-2203)
- ACT4: Gatekeeper: introduce 429 + retry-after heuristics for brief spikes (owner: Taylor, due: 2026-04-09, JIRA: RED-2204)
- ACT5: Update postmortem RACI + create cross-postmortem tracking ticket (owner: Ops, due: 2026-03-29, no-jira)
Liam O'Connor: I can take ACT2 but need to pair with infra to validate routing constraints. @Nora can you add infra contact in RED-2202?
Nora Li: Adding infra @eng-infra as reviewer. Also, ACT3 I need access to trace-store exports. @Taylor can you share the export location?
Taylor Nguyen: Trace export is at s3://redwood-postmortems/kv-inval/2026-02. Sent permissions to Nora and Priya.
DeployBot: Created JIRA RED-2201 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-2201)
DeployBot: Created JIRA RED-2202 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-2202)
DeployBot: Created JIRA RED-2203 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-2203)
DeployBot: Created JIRA RED-2204 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-2204)
Priya Shah: For ACT1, goal is a sub-minute alert with attached sample traces. I'll draft alert playbook and include a runbook snippet for on-call.
Liam O'Connor: For ACT2 rollout plan: feature flag + 25% canary for 24h, metric to watch: KV-miss-rate and tail-latency P99.5. Will add plan in RED-2202.
Nora Li: On ACT3, I'll create a small script to rehydrate missing traces and annotate them. ETA end of week.
OpsBot: Label added: recurrence; cross-postmortem tag set to RED-1987 (previous tokenization spike).
Taylor Nguyen: RACI draft: ACT1 responsible=Priya, accountable=Oncall Lead, consulted=Eng-ML, informed=Product. ACT2 responsible=Liam, accountable=Infra Lead, consulted=Priya, informed=Ops. ACT3 responsible=Nora, accountable=PM, consulted=Observability, informed=Postmortem list. I'll paste the RACI table into the doc.
Priya Shah: Quick question on handoffs: if an owner is OOO, what is our default fallback? Should we assign a temporary owner in the ticket or rely on the oncall rotation?
Liam O'Connor: Recommend explicit temp-owner in the ticket and an ops-ack comment. Less ambiguity.
Taylor Nguyen: Agreed. New rule: ticket template should include a "temp_owner" field and "expected_handoff_contact". Ops, can you add this to the template?
OpsBot: Updated ticket template to include temp_owner and handoff_contact fields.
Priya Shah: Can we set a weekly 10m sync until all ACTs are in progress? Tuesday 9:45am slot works for me.
Nora Li: Works for me as well. Please send cadences invite.
Taylor Nguyen: Calendar invite sent to participants + stakeholders. I'll keep a one-line status update in the postmortem doc after each sync.
Liam O'Connor: Noting recurrence pattern: similar symptoms seen in 2025-10 and 2025-12. I'll link those PMs in RED-2203 and propose a long-term mitigation epic if we see more recurrences.
Priya Shah: Added acceptance criteria for ACT1: alert triggers with attached traces, <1min signal-to-alert.
Taylor Nguyen: Thanks everyone. Final ask: update ownership in Jira and comment "owner-accept" by EOD so Ops can close the loop. I'll follow up after first sync with statuses. :thumbsup:
